## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Aris Musthafa_, Sep 30, 2026, 1/5: "⚠️ Guys, think twice before buying the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra in KSA. I purchased the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra (2025), but several health-related features, including ECG and Vital Check, are not working in Saudi Arabia. I contacted Samsung Customer Care to raise the issue, and they informed me that these features are not supported in KSA. I’m very disappointed because these are important features of the watch, and I wasn’t aware of this limitation before purchasing it."
            2. _Daniel Baumbart_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
